caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard cabinet with two main sections. The lower section consists of a wide rectangular base supported by four tapered and turned legs, featuring a pair of large curved doors at the front with oval inlays and brass-colored hardware. Above these doors is a long drawer adorned with two oval handles and a diamond-shaped keyhole. The upper section, which is narrower, contains a hutch with two glass doors divided by vertical and arched mullions, through which books with multicolored spines can be seen. The hutch is topped by a brass rail with small finials at each corner. The entire cabinet is rendered in shades of brown, with gold, brass, and blue accents along the hardware and railing. In the lower right corner, there is a small colored detail showing a horizontal decorative molding, combining dark brown, gold, and black in a repeating geometric pattern. The background is plain, off-white, and there is a small signature reading "Loughridge" in the bottom left corner.
title: Mahogany Desk with Bookcase Top
